query:
SELECT
                rfv.id as version_id,
                rfv.encrypted_name,
                rfv.name_nonce,
                rfv.name_blind_index,
                rfv.version,
                rfv.size,
                rfv.status,
                rfv.local_file_updated_at as file_updated_at,
                rfv.created_at
            FROM remote_file_versions rfv
            INNER JOIN backup_config bc
                ON bc.user_id = rfv.user_id
                AND bc.local_device_id = rfv.device_id
                AND bc.storage_id = rfv.storage_id
            WHERE rfv.user_id = $1
              AND bc.id = $2
              AND rfv.status = '"MovedToBin"'
            ORDER BY rfv.name_blind_index, rfv.version DESC
